sisi.depan: A wide river of bright yellow lava flows from a large fissure at the base of a towering, dark volcanic rock cliff.
sisi.kanan: A deep, hollowed-out alcove with walls lined in faintly glowing purple crystals is carved into a sheer cliff face of smooth, black rock.
sisi.kiri: A series of stepped rock ledges creates small, cascading waterfalls of orange lava that flow into a lower pool, crossed by a thin, twisted bridge of solidified lava rope.
sisi.belakang: Behind the viewpoint, a vast, flat plain of cracked black ground stretches towards distant, sharp mountain peaks silhouetted against the glowing horizon.

tengah: A narrow bridge formed from interlocking hexagonal basalt columns spans the main lava river, leading from the foreground towards the distant cliff.
atas: A perpetually twilight sky glows with warm red and gold hues, filled with slow-swirling clouds of dark ash and a shimmering heat haze rising from the lava below.
